reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Senior loan to Aztelekom LLC ("Aztelekom" or the "Borrower"), a state-owned company that provides telecommunication, internet and broadband services in Azerbaijan. The Bank will support the upgrade and rollout of Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) in the regions of Azerbaijan, replacing outdated technology with state-of-the-art fast-speed fixed telecommunication infrastructure. The project will support Aztelekom to (i) improve the quality and coverage of its services, particularly in rural areas, where private investor involvement is limited, (ii) optimize operational costs by using modern and low-maintenance equipment and (iii) reduce CO2 emission by switching to more energy efficient equipment in place of outdated technologies.
